name: Zarek
source:
“Listen carefully dearest human, and make no mistake. You’re mine and mine only until you pay back your debt to me.”

Audacious and arrogant, Zarek very fittingly holds the title of the Sinner of Pride. His alpha male tendencies get on your nerves at first, but you soon begin to realize that he’s not just a royal pain… Will this handsome demon allow you to stay by his side?

[Taken from [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.eveningcurse]Google Play[/url]]
